shortDefinition.en: An image-sensor technology that transfers collected signal charge through charge-coupled structures for readout.
shortDefinition.zh-cn: 通过电荷耦合结构转移已收集信号电荷以供读出的图像传感器技术。

en: CCD is not a compact-camera body category or a guarantee of film-like color.
zh-cn: CCD 不是卡片机外形类别，也不保证胶片般的色彩。

example.en: A scientific sensor and an older compact camera may both use CCD technology for very different purposes.
example.zh-cn: 科学传感器与老式卡片机可以都使用 CCD，但用途相差很大。

en: The transfer mechanism describes sensor operation. Specific designs differ in readout, noise and spectral response. In Chinese camera discussions “CCD” sometimes abbreviates an older CCD-equipped compact; expand that shorthand before attributing its appearance to the sensor alone.
zh-cn: 电荷转移机制描述传感器工作方式，具体设计在读出、噪声与光谱响应方面存在差异。中文讨论有时用“CCD”简称搭载 CCD 的老式卡片机，应先还原具体设备，再讨论其风格来自哪些因素。
